title: OneDrive pay-as-you-go storage reaches GA (rollout to Dec)
summary: Microsoft 365 OneDrive Storage, a pay-as-you-go meter that lets selected OneDrive accounts grow beyond their licensed quota, is rolling out to general availability for commercial tenants from early November to early December 2026 (MC1477185; roadmap 562352 'Rolling out'). Only usage above the licensed quota is billed, through a pay-as-you-go billing policy that needs an Azure subscription and resource group; the per-account maximum stays 25,600 GB. Government clouds are excluded for now, and if you disconnect billing while accounts are over quota, quota enforcement resumes.
why: It replaces 'buy Extra Storage for everyone' with per-account growth, but it is open-ended spend tied to an Azure subscription. Without budgets, a few large OneDrives can become a surprise bill.
todo: Decide whether you want it at all; if not, no action is needed.
If you enable it, set an Azure budget alert on the billing policy and raise limits only for named accounts.
Plan for disconnect: quota enforcement resumes for accounts that are over their licensed quota, so reduce usage first.
effective_note: GA rollout early Nov to early Dec 2026 per MC1477185 (updated 6 Oct 2026). Not for GCC/education/21Vianet at this time.
